text:
release-coordinator: Quick ops heads-up: we're pausing the APAC canary rollout for v3.5 model-routing changes — observed elevated 500s on dedicated pools during ramp. Freeze window in effect for ~45m while we triage. Details below.
oncall-bot: ALERT: Increased 500 errors on dedicated-gpu-pool-3 during canary ramp. Auto-notifications sent to oncall.
alex: I see the spikes too. Correlates with seq len >2048 requests. Kernel logs show a bunch of attention/alloc errors.
maria: can we revert quant-profile or fallback routing? I can trigger rollback if you want.
sam: pausing canaries now. Set routing fallback to v3.4 and throttled canary to 1r/s.
sam: commands I ran:
```
redwood rollout pause --canary apac-v3-5
redwood routing set-fallback --from v3.5 --to v3.4
```
june: QA will start smoke + perf on the fallback immediately. Please attach the sample prompt set.
alex: runtime error snippets show `ERR_ATTENTION_OVERFLOW` and some tensor alignment warnings — looks like kernel selection for long sequences.
maria: filing bug REG-471 with logs and perf dumps. tagging infra and runtime teams.
release-coordinator: Plan: 1) pause canary (done), 2) build hotfix for kernel selector, 3) run targeted smoke on staging, 4) resume canary with stricter throttles. ETA ~2h. If ETA >4h we'll open rollback ticket for full canary halt. @oncall please watch APAC + EU traffic.
oncall-bot: Pager duty: sam, alex. Notifying backups.
sam: I'm on it, will update every 15m. First update in ~15m.
june: QA ready — I'll validate perf and functional tests once staging build is up. Include `prompts/regression/apac_smoke.json`.
maria: pushed test build tag `hotfix/kernel-selector/2026-03-23` to staging, starting smoke run.
release-coordinator: If anyone needs a freeze-exception for infra-only or docs-only patches, DM me. Otherwise hold non-critical changes until we clear the canary.
alex: :thumbsup:
sam: +15m update: narrowed root cause to tensor alignment in CUDA kernel selection, patch queued and CI builds started.
release-coordinator: Thanks team — once we have green smoke on staging and kernel selector tests pass, we'll coordinate a controlled resume at low throttle. Will post final go/no-go here.
